suggestions.roleTitleVi: Chuyên viên Kế toán & Kiểm toán Thuế
suggestions.reasoning: Accounting and bookkeeping tasks exhibit 100% LLM exposure on routine computational and reporting workflows, making standard entry-level compliance vulnerable to automation. However, complex human advantage tasks such as strategic tax advisory, dispute resolution, and legal compliance under Vietnamese law remain deeply resilient.
suggestions.whyItFitsYou: Your 6 years of experience as a General Accountant with National Economics University training and MISA proficiency gives you a rock-solid foundation in compliance and ledger control. By bridging your gaps in data analysis and presentation, you can shift from routine bookkeeping to high-value tax advisory and financial storytelling.
